title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

**Corporate Secretary:** Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

**Accounting & Bookkeeping:** Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

**FinTech payments:** Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 500 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Singapore.

 **Requirements**

We are looking for a **Talent Acquisition Specialist** who is excited to be the ‘face of Sleek’—partnering with business leadership to attract and close exceptional talent across the region to drive our next phase of growth.  
  
Based in Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, India, or the Philippines this role reports directly to the Country Manager of Hong Kong, with a dotted line to the Head of Talent Acquisition.

**Key outcomes in the first 6-12 months:**

**Candidate quality & delivery**

* Bring in exceptional talent who are excited about Sleek and are a great fit for our stage of growth and culture.
* Execute end-to-end candidate screening across a variety of departments, delivering high-quality shortlists that consistently achieve a minimum 80% conversion rate from TA screen to Hiring Manager interview.

**Pipeline management**

* Review incoming applications promptly to maintain fast turnaround time and keep applicants engaged.
* Demonstrate creative problem-solving in sourcing and candidate engagement to build appropriate pipeline depth within the first few weeks of a role going live.
* Proactively source candidates to ensure the top of the funnel remains strong throughout the year.

**Business Partnering**

* Proactively build and manage relationships with Sleek’s hiring managers and Leadership team, soliciting feedback and working with the Head of Talent Acquisition to prioritise that feedback.

**Process & ATS Integrity**

* Maintain up-to-date candidate data within Workable to ensure seamless tracking and reporting.
* Ensure 100% compliance with Singapore recruitment regulations (MOM, Tripartite, MCF).
* Ensure job postings are of the highest quality and meet standards set by the Talent Acquisition team.

**Requirements:**

* **Language Proficiency:**
* + **All Applicants:** Fluent professional Business English (verbal and written) is strictly required as Sleek’s primary operational language.
  + Professional proficiency in Chinese (Cantonese and/or Mandarin; written Traditional and/or Simplified) is required for candidates supporting our Hong Kong and North Asia growth pipelines.
* **Legal Work Authorization:** Must hold existing legal working rights in your country of residence (Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, India or the Philippines).
* **Workplace Arrangement:** Comfortable with the applicable local working arrangement (**Hybrid** for Singapore and Hong Kong; **Fully Remote** for Malaysia, India, or the Philippines). Candidates across all locations in Malaysia, India, and the Philippines are welcome to apply.

**Nice-to-have experience:**

* Experience in full-cycle recruitment or client-facing roles.
* Experience operating in a fast-paced startup, scale-up, or high-growth environment.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

**Attention to detail:** You’ll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.

**Excellent listener and clear communicator:** We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn’t their first language. For you to excel, you’ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

**Tech + services savvy:** We are a tech-enabled services business, automating traditional, manual processes and delighting customers while doing so. You will thrive as someone who understands and is excited by the challenges and opportunities of utilising AI in this role to optimize candidate sourcing, streamline ATS workflows, and elevate overall hiring speed and quality.

**Collaboration-Driven:** You thrive in a cross-functional environment, working closely with hiring managers, department leads, and HR operations to ensure alignment on candidate profiles, hiring goals, and interview SLAs. You communicate effectively, advocate for candidate quality throughout the recruitment process, and proactively address pipeline bottlenecks before they impact hiring timelines, fostering a culture of shared accountability.

**Ownership:** This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

**Humility:** There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

**Structured thinking:** Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

### **The interview process**

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

**One-way Video Interview**

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview. This allows us to better understand your skills and experience early in the process and ensures a streamlined experience for all applicants.

**Technical Round**

A 60–90 minute interactive session with our Chief of Staff combining a background chat with a live case study. No preparation needed—we’ll explore how you tackle real-time hiring challenges.

**Soft Skills Assessment**

A ~45 minute chat with Country Manager Hong Kong, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

**Reference verification**

Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

**Requirement for background screening**

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

* Your education
* Any criminal history
* Any political exposure
* Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

 **Benefits**

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

**Humility and kindness:** Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

**Flexibility**: 3 days of work from home per week. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

**Financial benefits**: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

**Personal growth**: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

About the Role

We are a fast-growing startup looking for a proactive, responsible and multi-tasking HR & Operations Manager who can independently manage end-to-end recruitment, HR functions and daily business operations.

This role requires someone who is comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic and occasionally high-pressure startup environment.

Key Responsibilities

**1. End-to-End Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Manage complete recruitment cycles, from job posting to final onboarding.
* Handle hiring for junior, mid-level, senior and leadership positions.
* Prepare JDs, publish job openings and manage candidate pipelines.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed and other hiring platforms.
* Resume screening, shortlisting, initial interviews and interview coordination.
* Manage technical, non-technical, sales, marketing, creative and management hiring.
* Coordinate salary discussions, offer letters and joining formalities.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and hiring reports.

**2. HR Operations & Employee Management**

* Manage employee attendance, leaves, working hours and HR records.
* Handle employee onboarding, induction and exit formalities.
* Maintain employee databases and documentation.
* Manage offer letters, appointment letters, experience letters and other HR documents.
* Coordinate payroll processing, salary records and employee reimbursements.
* Handle employee queries, grievances and internal coordination.
* Maintain HR policies, SOPs and company guidelines.
* Manage performance review coordination and employee feedback.

**3. Performance & Workforce Management**

* Coordinate with department heads regarding team requirements.
* Track employee performance, productivity and attendance.
* Support performance appraisal and evaluation processes.
* Identify workforce requirements and hiring gaps.
* Manage employee engagement, retention and internal communication.
* Ensure teams follow company policies and operational processes.

**4. Administrative & Business Operations**

* Handle day-to-day office and administrative operations.
* Coordinate between different departments.
* Manage office requirements, vendors and internal resources.
* Maintain operational reports, trackers and documentation.
* Ensure smooth execution of internal processes.
* Take ownership of assigned operational responsibilities.

**5. HR Technology & Modern Recruitment**

* Knowledge of modern HRMS, ATS and recruitment tools.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri and other talent sourcing platforms.
* Ability to use AI tools such as ChatGPT for recruitment, documentation and workflow automation.
* Knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets and reporting dashboards.
* Ability to introduce process improvements and automate repetitive HR tasks.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in HR, recruitment and operations.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end recruitment.
* Excellent communication, coordination and negotiation skills.
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets and HR documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies and responsibilities simultaneously.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.
* Experience working in a startup or fast-paced organization is preferred.

Work Environment & Expectations

* We are a startup, and the working environment can be fast-paced and demanding.
* Must be comfortable handling multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
* Strong ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines is essential.
* Standard working days are Monday to Saturday.
* Occasionally, working hours may extend up to 10 hours depending on business requirements.
* On rare occasions, staying beyond regular working hours may be required, approximately 1–2 times a month, depending on workload.
* Must be flexible, proactive and solution-oriented.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable working a fixed 10-hour shift, 6 days a week (Monday to Saturday), in a fast-paced startup environment?

**Senior Assignment Support Coordinator**
  
Join a fast-paced, collaborative environment where accuracy, stakeholder engagement, and operational excellence are highly valued. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced professional who enjoys coordinating complex onboarding activities, managing assignment administration processes, and ensuring a seamless experience for contractors and internal stakeholders.
  
**What Youll Be Doing**

* **Contractor Onboarding:** Manage the end-to-end onboarding process, including document collection, verification, compliance checks, and contractor engagement to ensure a smooth start to every assignment.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:** Act as a key point of contact for internal teams, collaborating across functions to support assignment activities and maintain effective communication throughout the lifecycle of each engagement.
* **Assignment Documentation:** Prepare and maintain assignment-related correspondence, including offer letters, extensions, and termination documentation while ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures.
* **Application Management:** Utilise internal systems to manage assignment and contractor data, ensuring accurate records and providing support to stakeholders using these platforms.
* **Data Integrity:** Maintain and audit assignment and contractor records, proactively identifying and resolving discrepancies to ensure compliance and accuracy.
* **Reporting & Tracking:** Manage Excel spreadsheets and Smartsheets to monitor assignment progress, key deadlines, and operational metrics, producing reports that support business decision-making.

**Why NES Fircroft**

* **Career Growth:** Gain exposure to global workforce solutions and develop expertise across onboarding, contractor management, compliance, and operational processes.
* **Collaborative Culture:** Work alongside experienced professionals in a team-focused environment that values knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
* **Meaningful Impact:** Play a critical role in supporting assignment operations and delivering a positive experience for contractors and internal stakeholders.
* **Professional Development:** Enhance your skills through exposure to business systems, reporting tools, process optimisation initiatives, and cross-functional collaboration.

**What Were Looking For**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* **Relevant Experience:** Previous experience in contractor onboarding, administration, assignment support, or a similar operational role.
* **Technical Skills:** Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word, with experience using Smartsheet or similar platforms.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across multiple stakeholder groups.
* **Organisation & Accuracy:** Highly organised with strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate records and ensuring compliance.
* **Problem Solving:** Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing priorities, identify issues, and implement practical solutions.
* **Preferred Experience:** Exposure to HRIS platforms, contractor management processes, employment regulations, or project management methodologies would be advantageous.

**Who Are We?**

* **Global Expertise:** NES Fircroft is a leading workforce solutions provider, supporting clients across a range of industries with specialist talent and workforce management services.
* **Industry Reach:** We connect skilled professionals with exciting opportunities worldwide, helping organisations achieve their operational and project goals.
* **People Focused:** Our success is built on long-term relationships, exceptional service, and a commitment to supporting both clients and candidates.

**Accessibility & Inclusion**

* **Inclusive Workplace:** We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone is respected, valued, and given equal opportunity to succeed.
* **Accessible Recruitment:** If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, we encourage you to let us know so we can provide appropriate support.

description:
At NetApp, our High Achievement Principles shape how we work: we innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel as a team. We have a history of helping customers turn challenges into business opportunities. That’s because we bring new thinking to age-old problems, like how to use data most effectively in the most efficient possible way. As an Engineer with NetApp, you’ll have the opportunity to work with modern cloud and container orchestration technologies in a production setting. You’ll play an important role in scaling systems sustainably through automation and evolving them by pushing for changes to improve reliability and velocity.

**Success profile**
-------------------

Ready to be an engineer at NetApp? Explore the traits that can help you thrive.

* Analytical
* Adaptable
* Communicator
* Detail-oriented
* Quick-thinking
* Problem solver

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India **Job category:** Engineering **Job ID:** 137012-en\_US

**Own Every Moment at NetApp**

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager – Storage Engineering & SAN Protocols to lead a high-performing engineering team responsible for the design, development, qualification, and optimization of enterprise block storage technologies.

In this role, you will provide technical and people leadership across SAN, Fibre Channel (FC), iSCSI, NVMe-oF, and ONTAP-based storage solutions. You will drive engineering execution, influence technical direction, and partner with cross-functional teams to deliver highly available, scalable, and enterprise-ready storage capabilities.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

* Engineering Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of experienced storage engineers and developers while fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture.
* SAN & Block Storage Strategy: Drive technical direction and execution across Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NVMe/FC, and NVMe/TCP technologies.
* Technical Execution: Own engineering deliverables from architecture and development through qualification, integration, and General Availability (GA).
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, QA, Support, and other engineering teams to deliver complex storage capabilities and New Product Introduction (NPI) programs.
* Storage Architecture: Provide technical leadership in areas such as LUN provisioning, igroups, multipathing, fabric zoning, high availability, storage virtualization, and data protection.\
* Performance & Reliability: Drive improvements across storage performance, scalability, availability, resiliency, and interoperability.
* Enterprise Integration: Guide integration and interoperability of block storage solutions with platforms such as Linux/RHEL,
* Windows Server, VMware ESXi/vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V, and Cisco infrastructure.
* Technical Problem Solving: Lead resolution of complex system-level issues

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in enterprise storage, systems software, or storage engineering.
* 2–4+ years of people management or engineering leadership experience, preferably leading senior engineers.
* Strong hands-on technical background in SAN and block storage architectures.
* Deep understanding of Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NVMe-oF, NVMe/FC, and/or NVMe/TCP.
* Strong understanding of SAN fabrics, multipathing, zoning, LUN management, storage networking, and high-availability architectures.
* Experience with Linux/RHEL and at least one additional enterprise environment such as VMware ESXi/vSphere or Windows Server.
* Strong understanding of storage performance, scalability, reliability, and troubleshooting in large enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex engineering programs and collaborate across geographically distributed teams.

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification.

**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

**Our culture**

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now.

**Submitting an Application**

To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application.

**AI Disclosure**

For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support—rather than replace—human decision-making.

**Our values**
--------------

Put the customer at the center. Care for each other and our communities. Think and act like owners. Build belonging every day. Embrace a growth mindset.

The Learning Technology & Innovation (LTI) Team is focused on modernizing the US Member Firm’s learning architectures and its related processes as well as helping contribute to a streamlined learning technology ecosystem for the future. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact on achieving the US Member Firm’s learning vision and strategy by developing solutions that enable top-notch growth and development opportunities for our professionals.

**Work you'll do**

As a Specialist Manager, Talent Development on the Learning Technology & Innovation (LTI) team, you will be responsible for…

* Consult with Learning & Development (L&D) and business stakeholders to capture learner experience needs, document business requirements, and define solution requirements.
* Define system requirements and user stories with Deloitte Technology and other partner teams, applying standard requirements, sprint-scoping, backlog-tracking, testing, and defect-tracking processes.
* Support testing and integrations with Deloitte processes and systems, and translate business requirements into learning technology designs.
* Conduct research using focus groups, surveys, and interviews; synthesize findings; and develop learning technology points of view, frameworks, and innovation-roadmap deliverables.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy solution options and contribute to current, interim, and future-state learning ecosystem and learner-experience designs.
* Plan and manage complex projects; monitor status, risks, issues, and key performance indicators; develop stakeholder communications; and ensure timely delivery.

**The team**

The Learning Technology & Innovation (LTI) team modernizes the US Member Firm’s learning architecture, related processes, and technology ecosystem. The team collaborates with Learning & Development, Deloitte Technology, and business stakeholders to design technology-enabled learner experiences. Its work supports the learning vision and strategy by advancing growth and development opportunities for professionals.

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Shift Timings: 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST**

**Qualifications**

Required:

* Bachelor’s Degree
* 9+ years of experience in project or program management, business systems analysis, learning technology, or learning and development, including work in an onsite/offshore delivery model supporting clients in the United States and other countries

* Experience gathering, documenting, and analyzing business requirements; defining system requirements and user stories; and supporting technology solution design
* Experience using requirements templates, sprint-scoping or backlog-tracking tools, test plans, defect-tracking tools, and system-integration processes
* Experience conducting learner or stakeholder research through focus groups, surveys, or interviews and synthesizing findings into recommendations
* Experience using Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams to develop project documentation, stakeholder communications, and presentation materials

Preferred:

* Experience working with learning and development systems or corporate learning technology systems
* Experience in consulting or professional services

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

**Company:** White Collar Realty

**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana

**Job Type:** Full-time

**Experience:** 1 - 4 years

**Salary:** Competitive (commensurate with experience)

**About White Collar Realty**

White Collar Realty is a Gurugram-based real estate advisory company specializing in luxury and ultra-luxury properties across Gurgaon, Delhi NCR, Dubai, and the UAE.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a dynamic, target-driven **HR Recruiter** with prior experience in **real estate hiring** to join our HR team in Gurugram. You will manage the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle—from sourcing high-caliber real estate sales executives, relationship managers, and corporate professionals to onboarding top talent. The ideal candidate understands real estate hiring dynamics, possesses a strong network of industry talent, and thrives in a fast-paced recruitment environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Real Estate Hiring:** Manage full-cycle recruitment for real estate roles, including Sales Executives, Business Development Managers (BDMs), Relationship Managers, Team Leaders, and back-office corporate staff.
* **Talent Sourcing & Networking:** Source qualified candidates through job portals (Naukri, Indeed), LinkedIn Recruiter, real estate networks, referrals, and headhunting from competing real estate brokerages and developers.
* **Screening & Assessment:** Screen resumes, conduct initial telephonic assessments, evaluate candidates' sales acumen and market knowledge, and coordinate face-to-face interviews with hiring managers.
* **Pipeline & Database Management:** Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for recurring sales and leadership positions across our Gurgaon and Dubai operations.
* **Offer Negotiation & Onboarding:** Coordinate salary negotiations, issue offer letters, and ensure a smooth pre-joining and onboarding experience to minimize drop-offs.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Industry Experience:** 1–4 years of hands-on recruitment experience, with **mandatory prior experience hiring for the real estate sector** (consultancies, channel partners, or developers).
* **Domain Understanding:** Solid understanding of real estate sales hierarchies, commission/incentive-driven roles, and the NCR/Dubai property talent landscape.
* **Sourcing Expertise:** Proficiency in using job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn), social media hiring, and cold-calling passive candidates.
* **Communication & Negotiation:** Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to pitch opportunities effectively and negotiate offers.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration (BBA/MBA), or a related field.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Fast-paced, collaborative work environment with direct exposure to senior leadership.
* Clear career progression path within HR and Talent Acquisition.

------------------

At Cogstate, we help improve the quality and reliability of clinical trial data by providing specialized clinical assessment, training, and quality oversight solutions to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies around the world.

Our team partners with sponsors and research sites to support the consistent administration, scoring, and review of clinical outcome assessments across global clinical trials. Through services including central scoring, central review, image-based review, rater training and certification, calibration, and quality review and remediation, we help reduce variability, strengthen data quality, and ensure greater confidence in clinical trial endpoints.

Our work spans multiple therapeutic areas, including dermatology, where we engage experienced clinicians to bring indication-specific and scale-specific expertise to clinical trial programs. Our experts help ensure assessments are performed and evaluated consistently, from training and certifying site raters to centrally reviewing scores and images and identifying opportunities for remediation.

Our global team brings together clinical, scientific, operational, data, and technology expertise to solve complex challenges in clinical trials. At Cogstate, our goal is simple: to help sponsors generate high-quality, reliable data that supports confident decision-making throughout clinical development.

**About the Clinician Network**
-------------------------------

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.  
  
Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

**About the Role**
------------------

Cogstate is seeking experienced Dermatologists to support clinical research studies through a range of centralized assessment and quality oversight services. In this fully remote, contract-based role, clinicians may perform **Central Scoring, Central Review, Image-Based Review, Site Rater Training & Certification, Calibration Activities, and Quality Review & Remediation** across a variety of dermatology clinical trials.

Cogstate provides comprehensive, fully compensated training on study protocols, scoring methodologies, review processes, and operational requirements before clinicians begin study work. Ongoing calibration exercises and quality oversight activities help ensure consistency, reliability, and regulatory compliance across all study assessments.

Depending on study needs and individual expertise, consultants may contribute to one or more service areas, including:

* **Central Scoring:** Independent scoring and interpretation of dermatology-specific clinician-reported and observer-reported outcome measures.
* **Central Review:** Secondary review of completed assessments to ensure accuracy, consistency, and protocol adherence.
* **Image-Based Review:** Evaluation of clinical photographs and imaging data to assess disease severity, treatment response, and endpoint compliance.
* **Site Rater Training & Certification:** Training, certifying, and supporting site-based raters on proper scale administration and scoring procedures.
* **Calibration Activities:** Participating in ongoing calibration exercises to maintain inter-rater reliability and scoring consistency across global studies.
* **Quality Review & Remediation:** Identifying assessment quality issues, providing corrective feedback, and supporting remediation efforts to improve data quality and protocol compliance.

These are fully-remote, contract positions. Work is provided on an as-needed basis and scheduled according to clinician availability.

* MD or DO with specialization in Dermatology.
* Board-certified or board-eligible Dermatologist preferred.
* Active and unrestricted medical license in a relevant jurisdiction.
* Minimum 3-5 years of post-training clinical practice experience in dermatology.
* Experience evaluating and managing patients with dermatologic conditions in clinical, academic, or research settings.
* Demonstrated experience with dermatology clinical outcome assessments, disease severity scales, and clinician-reported outcome measures.
* Experience with one or more dermatology indications such as atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, vitiligo, hidradenitis suppurativa, alopecia areata, prurigo nodularis, eczema, chronic pruritus, or other inflammatory and rare dermatologic disorders.
* Familiarity with dermatology rating scales and assessments such as EASI, IGA, SCORAD, PASI, DLQI, VASI, PP-NRS, HiSCR, CDLQI, and other study-specific outcome measures.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to consistently apply scoring criteria and identify assessment quality issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide training, feedback, and remediation guidance to site personnel.
* Proficiency with telehealth platforms, Microsoft Office applications, and web-based clinical trial systems.

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1736756

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- SailPoint IIQ senior**
===============================================

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The Opportunity**

We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis

In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.

  

As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 3-7 years of experience in designing and deploying IIQ-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions
* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.
* Should have experience in implementing at least one complete IAM SDLC engagements projects. This must include activities such as requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and application support
* Must have experience in SailPoint IIQ & IDN architecture, design, development, configuration, testing, integration, and deployment.
* Must have experience in source/ Identity profile configuration, transform/rule development, workflow configuration, JML process and certification, Password sync.
* Must have experience in onboarding AD, JDBC and web service applications to IIQ/IDN
* Must have experience in deployment of virtual appliance, understanding different VA architecture, deploy rules in cloud/VA, High availability/DR configuration
* Configuration and deployment of IQService in cloud and on-prem environments
* Must have hands on experience in configuring quick link, custom work flow, reports, developing service account management modules, integration with other tools like Service Now, CyberArk etc and plugin development
* IIQ Installation, set up and initial configuration/ upgradation to different versions of IIQ, Standard service build set up and configuration
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  

**What we offer you**

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

  

**Our Commitment**: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

**Professional Development**: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

**People and Culture**: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

**Benefits**: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

**How to Apply**: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Job Description:**

**What’s the role**

The IT Operations Lead is end-to-end responsible for the support and delivery of the M365 Operations to the Information & Digital Services Operations (IDSO) organisation. They will manage in-house operations as well as multiple suppliers supporting Shell to ensure issues and problems are resolved end to end. The Operations Lead additionally acts as the escalation point between Business IT and 3rd party provided for any deterioration in service levels.

Provide superior technical advice for changes to application architecture design. Guide and advise others being the subject matter expert in technical / operational aspects. Assist with supportability and transition activities of enhancements and new projects. Provide management information and reporting for the service.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Lead the end-to-end operations, support, and service delivery of Microsoft 365 services, ensuring high availability, performance, and compliance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Operational Level Agreements (OLAs).
* Manage and oversee Microsoft 365 tenant operations, including Messaging Services, Scripting, Exchange Online, Exchange On-Premises, Exchange Online Protection (EOP), Email Relay Services, and Enterprise Vault.
* Act as the primary escalation point for service-related incidents, problems, and service degradation between business stakeholders, IT teams, and third-party service providers.
* Drive incident, problem, and change management activities to ensure timely resolution, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvement.
* Provide technical leadership and subject matter expertise on Messaging, Tenant Operations, Microsoft 365 administration, and platform supportability.
* Support solution architecture reviews by providing technical and operational recommendations for system enhancements, integrations, and new projects.
* Lead supportability, transition, and operational readiness activities for new services, enhancements, and projects.
* Monitor Microsoft Message Center and Service Health dashboards, assess service impacts, and coordinate user communications for planned and unplanned service events.
* Collaborate with architecture, delivery, planning, and supplier teams to ensure operational excellence and seamless service delivery.
* Drive automation, DevOps adoption, and Intelligent Operations initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance service reliability.
* Analyze and approve new service integrations, ensuring alignment with technical standards, security requirements, and best practices.
* Ensure compliance with information security policies, IT controls, regulatory requirements, and audit standards across all supported services.
Support global operations through participation in after-hours support activities, major incident management, and on-call rotations as required.  

**What you bring**

* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or anything related.
* Atleast 8 years of experience supporting enterprise collaboration platforms, messaging systems, or Microsoft 365 services within large, complex, and geographically distributed organizations.
* Expert-level knowledge of Microsoft 365 Messaging Services, Scripting, and Tenant Operations.
* Hands-on experience managing Exchange Online, Exchange On-Premises, Exchange Online Protection (EOP), and hybrid messaging environments.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft 365 license administration, Azure AD Groups, and Microsoft 365 Groups.
* Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments and integrating cloud services with on-premises infrastructure.
* Proven experience in troubleshooting, incident management, problem management, and service restoration activities.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Message Center, Service Health monitoring, and end-user service communications.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 Guest Access, third-party integrations, and enterprise collaboration services.
* Demonstrated expertise in IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, service integration, and supplier management.
* Ability to translate technical requirements into business-focused solutions and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and investigative skills.
* Experience working in global, cross-functional, matrixed organizations and supporting teams across multiple time zones.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, influence stakeholders, and resolve operational conflicts effectively.
* Working knowledge of ITIL, DevOps, and service lifecycle management practices.
* Experience leading operational improvements, automation initiatives, and continuous service optimization programs.
Willingness to participate in on-call rotations and provide support outside standard business hours.  

**Additional Qualifications but not mandatory:**

* ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert or related Microsoft certifications.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation within Microsoft 365 environments.
* Exposure to AI-driven operations (AIOps), Intelligent Operations, and automation solutions.
* Experience leading digital transformation, operational excellence, or cloud modernization initiatives.
Knowledge of enterprise retention, archiving, and email compliance solutions such as Enterprise Vault.  

**What we offer**

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
* Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
* Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.  

We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal, **.**

**IMPORTANT NOTE:** **After you submit your application, you will receive an email providing a link to an online assessment that is a mandatory part of the process. The email will come from HireVue - please check your spam/junk mailbox if you do not see the email. Once completed, your application will be reviewed to determine next steps. Thank you for your interest in Shell.**



**Shell India**

Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in R&D, digitalisation, and business operations.

Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.

Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.

Shell owns and operates a LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and a LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India’s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Sprng Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Sprng is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.

Our three capability centres across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.

We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programmes on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
HR Manager – Manufacturing

* **Company:** Fluidteq Systems Pvt. Ltd. (FSPL)
* **Location:** Vasai East, Palghar (manufacturing plant), with regular visits to our head office in Goregaon East, Mumbai
* **Experience:** Minimum 4–5 years of HR experience in a manufacturing organisation (mandatory)
* **Reports to:** CEO & Director – Operations
* **Employment type:** Full-time, on-site
* **CTC:** ₹6 **– ₹9** LPA, based on experience *(fill in before posting)*

About Fluidteq Systems

Fluidteq Systems Pvt. Ltd. (FSPL) is a Mumbai-based precision engineering company that makes instrumentation tube fittings, valves and manifolds. Founded in 2004, we have manufactured in-house on CNC machines since 2008.

We have supplied over 5 million fittings to Indian Railways coach and locomotive factories and to metro projects. We are an approved vendor to EIL, ONGC and ADNOC, and hold ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications. Our customers are in railways, metro, oil & gas, power and defence, in India, the UAE, Qatar, Italy and Indonesia.

We are now expanding into a new 45,000 sq ft integrated manufacturing facility, and we need an HR leader who can grow the team with it.

About the role

You will own the complete HR function — from hiring a CNC operator on Monday to closing payroll and statutory filings at month-end. This is a hands-on role in a lean, growing company: you will do the work yourself, build the systems, and be the person both employees and management trust.

Your first-year priorities: a reliable hiring pipeline for the shop floor, clean and compliant payroll, and HR practices fully aligned with India's new Labour Codes.

Key responsibilities1. Shop-floor and blue-collar hiring

* Hire CNC and VMC operators and setters, conventional machinists, QC inspectors, assembly, packing and dispatch staff, helpers and material-handling labour.
* Build steady sourcing channels: ITIs, polytechnics, local placement agencies, labour contractors, employee referrals, walk-in drives and job apps such as Apna, WorkIndia and Indeed.
* Organise practical trade tests with Production and QC — machine operation, drawing reading, and use of verniers, micrometers and gauges.
* Keep a ready pipeline of pre-screened operators so no critical machine sits idle for want of manpower.
* Run apprentice and trainee hiring under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

2. Recruitment across all levels

* Recruit for engineering, quality, production, PPC, purchase, sales and marketing, accounts and admin — from trainee to manager level.
* Write job descriptions, post on LinkedIn, Indeed and Naukri, and manage recruitment consultants.
* Screen resumes, shortlist, run telephonic and first-round interviews, and coordinate panel interviews with department heads.
* Run reference and background checks, negotiate offers, and issue offer and appointment letters.
* Track hiring metrics: time-to-fill, offer-to-join ratio, cost per hire and 90-day attrition.
* Own onboarding: joining documents, UAN and ESIC enrolment, safety induction and a first-week plan.

3. Payroll and wage administration

* Run end-to-end monthly payroll for staff and workers: biometric attendance, leave, shifts, overtime, incentives, deductions and arrears.
* Structure wages to meet the Code on Wages definition of "wages", including the 50% cap on excluded allowances.
* Apply Maharashtra minimum wages and VDA revisions on time.
* PF: monthly ECR filing, UAN and KYC upkeep, transfers and claims support — including the revised ₹25,000 EPF wage ceiling effective 17 September 2026.
* ESIC: employee registration, monthly contributions, accident reporting and benefit-claim support.
* Maharashtra Professional Tax and Labour Welfare Fund deductions and filings.
* Coordinate salary TDS and employee tax declarations with Accounts.
* Calculate statutory bonus, gratuity, leave encashment and overtime at twice the ordinary rate.
* Complete full-and-final settlements within the timelines set by the Code on Wages.
* Issue payslips and keep wage registers and records up to date.

4. Statutory compliance — Labour Codes and Maharashtra law

* Lead FSPL's move from the old labour laws to the four Labour Codes in force since 21 November 2025 — the Code on Wages, Industrial Relations Code, Code on Social Security and OSH Code — and the Central Rules notified in May 2026.
* Track Maharashtra's state rules under the Codes and update our practices as they are finalised.
* Manage factory registration and licence compliance under the OSH Code, including for our new facility, and liaise with the Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH).
* Issue appointment letters to every employee, as the OSH Code requires.
* Maintain statutory registers, records and returns, digitally wherever permitted.
* Enforce working-hour, weekly-off, overtime and leave rules, and arrange annual health check-ups for eligible workers.
* Manage contract labour: verify contractors' registration, wage payments, PF and ESIC, and meet our duties as principal employer.
* Run the Internal Committee under the POSH Act, 2013: constitution, awareness training, complaint handling and the annual report.
* Set up and run a Grievance Redressal Committee as required under the Industrial Relations Code.
* Administer maternity benefit, employees' compensation and equal-pay obligations under the Codes.
* Keep the Goregaon office registered and compliant under the Maharashtra Shops and Establishments Act, 2017.
* Verify age at hiring and ensure zero child or adolescent labour.
* Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and handle labour, EPFO, ESIC and factory inspections with complete records.
* Provide HR and labour-compliance evidence for customer vendor audits and our ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 audits.

5. Employee relations, discipline and conflict

* Be the first point of contact for grievances, and resolve disputes between workers, shifts and supervisors fairly and quickly.
* Tackle absenteeism, late coming and indiscipline through counselling, warnings and documented corrective action.
* Run the disciplinary process: show-cause notices, charge sheets and domestic enquiries that follow natural justice.
* Draft, communicate and enforce HR policies and the code of conduct.
* Handle sensitive situations calmly — workplace injuries, harassment complaints, misconduct and family emergencies — working with ESIC, hospitals and families as needed.
* Manage exits: resignations, terminations, exit interviews, and relieving and experience letters.
* Keep open, regular communication with the shop floor in Marathi and Hindi.

6. Performance, training and engagement

* Run the annual appraisal cycle, with KRAs agreed with department heads.
* Maintain the operator skill matrix and training records that ISO competence requirements call for.
* Plan on-the-job, safety and multi-skilling training with Production, QC and EHS.
* Improve operator retention through attendance incentives, recognition and engagement activities.

7. HR operations and MIS

* Maintain employee files and data in our HRMS and payroll software.
* Present a monthly HR MIS to management: headcount, open positions, attrition, overtime, manpower cost and compliance status.
* Plan manpower with Production for capacity growth and the new facility.
* Coordinate HR administration: ID cards, uniforms, PPE issue records, attendance devices and service vendors.

RequirementsMust have

* Graduate in any discipline, plus an MBA/PGDM in HR, MSW, MLS or DLL&LW.
* At least 4–5 years of hands-on HR experience in a manufacturing organisation — this is mandatory.
* A proven record of hiring blue-collar staff in volume, such as CNC/VMC operators, machinists and helpers.
* Independent handling of monthly payroll, PF, ESIC, Professional Tax and Labour Welfare Fund.
* Working knowledge of the four Labour Codes and Maharashtra labour law, with experience facing statutory inspections.
* Experience handling grievances, disciplinary action and domestic enquiries.
* Fluent in Marathi and Hindi, with good written and spoken English.
* Strong in MS Excel (lookups, pivot tables) and comfortable with payroll or HRMS software.
* Willing to be based at our Vasai East plant.

Good to have

* Experience in an engineering, machining or precision manufacturing company.
* Exposure to ISO 9001, 14001 or 45001 audits, or customer vendor audits.
* Experience setting up HR for a new plant or a growing MSME.
* Experience with contract labour, apprenticeship schemes and POSH committees.

You are

* Firm but fair — respected on the shop floor and trusted by management.
* Organised, deadline-driven and discreet with confidential data.
* Calm under pressure and comfortable having difficult conversations.

What we offer

* Full ownership of the HR function, with direct access to the CEO.
* The chance to build HR for a new 45,000 sq ft facility as we scale.
* Work with a company that supplies Indian Railways, metro projects and global oil & gas companies.
* A competitive CTC and all statutory benefits.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* HR sourcing: 4 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

* Experience with functional testing, UAT coordination, defect management, and production support

Join Deloitte Cyber's Data and Digital Trust practice as a Senior Engineering Management Specialist and help clients secure Databricks Lakehouse environments. You will assess security posture, implement governance and access controls, and integrate security capabilities across cloud data platforms. You will collaborate with client, delivery, and vendor teams to deliver practical solutions that support privacy, regulatory, and business objectives.

**Work you'll do**

As a Senior Engineering Management Specialist on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for:

* Assess Databricks Lakehouse environments, including workspaces, Unity Catalog, clusters, SQL warehouses, notebooks, jobs, and data pipelines; identify security and regulatory gaps; and prioritize remediation.
* Design and implement data governance and access-control models using Unity Catalog, including metastores, catalogs, schemas, grants, row filters, column masks, and attribute-based access controls.
* Configure platform, network, and identity controls, including private connectivity, secure cluster connectivity, Internet Protocol (IP) access lists, cluster policies, secrets management, customer-managed encryption keys, single sign-on (SSO), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) provisioning, and least-privilege access.
* Implement data classification, tagging, lineage, masking, tokenization, Delta Sharing, clean rooms, and cross-cloud or cross-workspace access for sensitive data.
* Enable audit logging and monitoring; integrate Databricks with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR), and cloud security tools; evaluate complementary governance tools; and create architecture and operational documentation with client, delivery, and vendor teams.

**The team**

Data and Digital Trust practice is primarily focused on helping our clients to utilize effective data while safeguarding privacy and security. D&DT solutions prioritize transparency, privacy, and the ethical use of data, assisting organizations in driving sustainable digital transformation. Our solutions assist organizations in meeting the shifting expectations of consumers and create unprecedented business opportunities. We help our clients to define their overall Data protection and Privacy strategy, design global pan-enterprise programs that focus on mitigating threats, evaluate their objectives, priorities, strengths and weaknesses and roll out large scale organizational changes to achieve goals. Our services capture work across advice, implement, and operate solutions. The Data and Digital Trust team delivers services to clients through following key areas:

* Privacy Governance & Compliance
* Data Protection & Compliance
* Digital Trust & Online Protection
* Risk & Controls Enablement
* Technology & Implementation

Our Data and Digital Trust solutions are designed to allow organizations to address requirements stemming from the ever-changing regulatory landscape, consumer expectations, and technological transformations and advancements.

**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**

**Shift Timings: General shift**

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 5–8 years of experience in data security, data protection, or cloud security, including 2+ years securing Databricks environments.
* Experience configuring Databricks security features, including Unity Catalog, access controls, secrets, cluster policies, audit logs, and encryption.
* Experience implementing data classification, masking, and fine-grained access controls in a Lakehouse or big-data environment.
* Experience with data and network security controls in Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience using Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), and infrastructure as code with Terraform to automate security configurations.
* Experience integrating Databricks with identity platforms and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools, and creating technical documentation or delivering client training.
* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent

Preferred:

* Experience with Cyera, Immuta, Privacera, Collibra, BigID, Securiti.ai, or Microsoft Purview.
* Experience with Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Delta Sharing, or artificial intelligence and machine learning workload security using MLflow, model serving, or Mosaic AI.
* One or more of the following: Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional certification; Databricks Platform Administrator accreditation; Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA); Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP); Certified Information Security Manager (CISM); Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP); or a cloud security certification from AWS, Azure, or GCP.

title: R&D Data Product Manager
description:
Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com (https://www.astellas.com/en)
  
Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?
  
We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

**Purpose and Scope:**

The R&D Domain Data Product Manager develops recommendations for and activates the approved data product strategy for an assigned biopharma R&D domain. Working with the Data Domain Owner and scientific, clinical, data, architecture, governance, engineering and platform stakeholders, the role identifies high-value user and business needs and translates them into a coherent portfolio of reusable data products. It establishes proposed product boundaries, value hypotheses and roadmaps, incorporates quality and governance expectations defined with data stewards and relevant specialists, and recommends investment priorities for approval by the Data Domain Owner.
  
The role owns domain-level product discovery, portfolio prioritization recommendations, product mobilization and cross-product dependency management within approved priorities and investment guardrails. It coordinates validation of scientific relevance and consumer needs with scientific and clinical stakeholders; technical feasibility and interoperability with architecture, modeling, engineering and platform teams; and quality, governance, privacy and analytical and AI-use readiness with data stewards, governance specialists and relevant privacy and technical authorities. Once a product is approved and sufficiently defined, detailed delivery and lifecycle accountability transitions to a designated Data Product Owner. The Domain Data Product Manager retains responsibility for domain-wide portfolio coherence, cross-product dependencies, portfolio-level value tracking, identification of reuse opportunities and alignment with the approved domain strategy.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Partner with the Data Domain Owner to translate domain outcomes, use cases, investment priorities, and OKRs into a clear domain data product vision, roadmap, and strategic backlog.
* Establish and continuously refine a prioritized domain backlog covering candidate data products, domain blueprint work, source dependencies, data contracts, governance needs, and enabling platform capabilities.
* Work with the Domain Data Architect and Domain Data Modelers to develop and maintain the domain blueprint, product decomposition, canonical/semantic modeling priorities, interoperability needs, and reusable architecture patterns.
* Facilitate use-case decomposition into required data products, MVP boundaries, capabilities, sequencing, business value hypotheses, and measurable success criteria.
* Coordinate demand intake, opportunity evaluation, value/effort prioritization, dependency mapping, and escalation of cross-domain or platform constraints; make trade-offs transparent to the Domain Owner.
* Maintain a consolidated view of domain initiatives, product status, backlog readiness, delivery milestones, capacity assumptions, risks, decisions, and strategic dependencies.
* Engage the Foundation Data Platform team to align on source availability, ingestion needs, technical readiness, shared standards, and planned capability changes without taking ownership of platform engineering.
* Partner with Data Governance Specialists and stewards to embed ownership, business glossary, metadata, data quality, lineage, contract, certification, privacy, and AI-readiness expectations into domain planning.
* Define product initiation and handoff criteria; identify and onboard the accountable Data Product Owner before detailed product delivery begins.
* Transition each approved product's delivery backlog, acceptance criteria, releases, consumer engagement, adoption, and ongoing lifecycle management to its Data Product Owner; provide portfolio-level coordination thereafter.
* Facilitate domain planning, backlog refinement, roadmap reviews and cross-team dependency forums with Core and Value Teams.
